taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-b-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station T-21 (survey area T). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 27.0 | 38.35 | 38.35
2 | 28.6 | 3.21 | 41.56
3 | 27.8 | 26.07 | 67.63
4 | 30.8 | - | -

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: T-21
Curve type: KH
Aquifer depth: 41.6 – 67.6 m
Recommendation: Drill to a minimum depth of 75 m to fully penetrate the potential aquifer layer (Layer 3) and terminate in the basal formation. Install screens between 42 m and 67 m with gravel packing to optimize groundwater abstraction.
